# elastic_wave_1d

1D elastic wave propagation in a column (thesis Sec. 6.4.1): validation of the
implicit time integrators for the momentum inertia term of `engine_pm_cpu`
(`darts.engines.time_integration`).

## Test

* Column `[0, 1] x [0, 1] x [0, 10]` m, hexahedral mesh generated by
  `darts.tools.gen_msh.generate_box_3d` (`meshes/column_<nz>_<nxy>x<nxy>.msh`),
  `pm_discretizer`, pure elasticity (flow and Biot coupling off:
  `apply_geomechanics_mode(mode=2)`, `biot = 0`).
* `E = 1 GPa`, `nu = 0.25`, `rho = 2406 kg/m3` -> `c_p = sqrt((lambda + 2 mu) / rho) = 706.2 m/s`.
* Rollers on all faces; at the top (`BND_Z+`) the normal displacement
  `u_z(t) = -0.01 m` for `0 < t <= 1e-3 s` (rectangular pulse, `STUCK_ROLLER`, updated every
  (sub-)step through `ColumnReservoir.set_top_displacement`).
* Analytical solution (d'Alembert, valid before the first reflection at `t = H / c_p = 0.01416 s`):
  `u_z(z, t) = u_top(t - (H - z) / c_p)`.
* Default run: `nz = 100` (`dz = 0.1 m`), `CFL = c_p dt / dz = 0.706` (`dt = 1e-4 s`), 120 steps to
  `t = 0.012 s`, profiles at `t = 0.002` and `0.012 s`.
* Metrics per snapshot (`results.json`, `errors`): `l2` (`sqrt(sum (u - u_a)^2 dz)`), `l2_rel`
  (`l2 / ||u_a||`), `linf`, `overshoot` (`max |u| - |u_pulse|`, clipped at 0), `wake` (max `|u|` more
  than 10 cells behind the pulse tail; empty, i.e. 0, while the tail is less than 10 cells below the top),
  `layer_nonuniformity` (spread of `u_z` across the cells of one layer, ~roundoff for a 1D solution).

## Schemes (`--scheme`, `--params '{...}'`; `main.apply_scheme`)

| scheme | engine | parameters (default) |
|---|---|---|
| `backward_euler` | `time_integration.BACKWARD_EULER` (legacy 3-point BE on `Xn1/Xn/X`) | - |
| `newmark` | `set_newmark(gamma, beta)` (displacement form) | `gamma` 0.5, `beta` 0.25 |
| `generalized_alpha` | `set_generalized_alpha(rho_inf)` (Chung-Hulbert) | `rho_inf` 0.8 |
| `hht` | `set_hht_alpha(alpha)` | `alpha` -0.1 |
| `bathe` | `time_integration.BATHE` composite (trapezoidal over `bathe_gamma dt`, 3-point backward over the rest) | `bathe_gamma` 0.5 |

Common parameter `kv_damping` (default 0): Kelvin-Voigt artificial viscosity `q`
(`q K_uu (u^{n+1} - u^n)`, `eta = q dt`).

The Bathe sub-stepping is done by `MechanicsNewtonSolver.run_timestep`; the driver sets the
top displacement at the sub-step end time through the solver's `on_substep` hook (an older
solver without the hook is driven with two explicit `run_timestep` calls and
`engine.bathe_substep = 1, 2`). A failed step aborts the run (no retry); a retry must not call
`reservoir.update()` again (it would overwrite the level-n boundary data `bc_rhs_prev`).

## Caveat: `nxy >= 2`

A one-cell-wide column (`nxy = 1`) makes the `pm_discretizer` roller stencils degenerate
(`u_x`/`u_y` transmissibilities ~1e30 in the lateral gradient reconstruction); the default is
`2 x 2` cells across, and the profiles are averaged over the cells of each layer.

## Usage

```
python main.py --scheme generalized_alpha --params '{"rho_inf": 0.5}' --nz 100 --cfl 0.706
python compare_schemes.py --nz 100 --cfl 0.706     # sweep of 13 scheme/parameter cases (~2 min)
python convergence_study.py                        # joint dz/dt refinement, step and smooth pulses (~15 min)
python backward_euler_norms.py                     # backward Euler, step pulse, three error measures (~10 min)
python main.py --test all                          # regression cases (see below)
```

## Figures (`figures/`)

* `step_wave_comparison.png` (from `compare_schemes.py`): all methods against the analytical propagating
  step wave at t = 2 ms and 12 ms, grouped into second-order schemes without stabilizer, numerically
  dissipative schemes (backward Euler, generalized-alpha rho_inf = 0, Newmark gamma = 0.6, HHT alpha = -0.3)
  and Kelvin-Voigt stabilized schemes; `step_wave_all_schemes.png` is the one-panel-per-scheme version and
  `step_wave_summary.md` the metric table (L2, Linf, overshoot, wake, Newton iterations).
* `convergence.png` / `convergence.md` (from `convergence_study.py`): L2 error versus cell size for every
  scheme under joint refinement at CFL 0.706 (nz = 50, 100, 200, 400), for the rectangular pulse of the
  thesis (discontinuous solution: at most first order, front dominated by spatial dispersion) and for a
  smooth raised-cosine pulse of 2 ms (temporal order observable: second order for Newmark trapezoidal,
  generalized-alpha, HHT and Bathe; first order for backward Euler, Newmark gamma = 0.6 and the
  Kelvin-Voigt-damped variants), with reference slopes 1 and 2 and the observed orders in the table.

* `backward_euler_norms.png` / `backward_euler_norms.md` (from `backward_euler_norms.py`): backward Euler on
  the rectangular pulse (nz = 50..800, CFL 0.706) at t = 2 ms and 12 ms in the mesh-weighted L2 norm (order
  1/4: the L2 error of a diffusively smeared jump), the L1 norm (order 1/2) and the per-cell-normalised
  Euclidean norm `|u_z - u_zh|_2 / N` of thesis Fig. 6.1b (order 3/4, which reads as "first order with
  respect to sqrt(dz dt)" there); see `docs/technical_reference/dynamic_mechanics.md`.

The `figures/convergence_runs/` and `figures/backward_euler_runs/` directories with the individual runs are
git-ignored.

## Regression test (`run_test`)

`main.run_test([case, overwrite], platform='cpu')` (convention of `models/run_test_suite2.py`)
runs `nz = 50`, `CFL = 0.706` (`dt = 2e-4 s`), 30 steps to `t = 0.006 s` for
`case` in `backward_euler`, `generalized_alpha_0.5` (`rho_inf = 0.5`), `bathe` (`bathe_gamma = 0.5`)
or `all`, and compares the layer-averaged `u_z` profile at `t = 0.006 s` with `ref/<case>.npz`
(`np.allclose(rtol=1e-8, atol=1e-10)`); `overwrite = '1'` or a missing reference (re)writes it and
returns `(0, 0.0)`. Run outputs go to `sol_test_<case>/` (git-ignored).
